title: HDFC Bank to Hire Headhunter After CEO’s Surprise Exit
summary: HDFC Bank Ltd. is seeking to hire a search firm to fast-track the appointment of a new chief executive officer, according to people with knowledge of the matter, an indication of how India’s top private-sector lender was caught unawares by incumbent Sashidhar Jagdishan deciding to step down.

title: PG&E Falls on Liability Bill; Nvidia Rises on Chip Investment | Stock Movers
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- PG&E (PGE) are extending their downward move as California legislators introduced a bill that would update the state’s wildfire response without shifting liability away from publicly traded utilities. At least three research firms, including BMO Capital Markets and Wells Fargo, downgraded the stock.  
- Chevron (CVX) and ExxonMobil (XOM) shares are rising along with the price of oil. Washington and Tehran exchanged strikes for the first time in about a month, with US Central Command targeting rocket launchers preparing to send mines into the Strait of Hormuz. In response, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said that it had attacked US air bases in Jordan.
- Nvidia (NVDA) shares are rising after the leader in AI chips dropped 4.6% Friday. It's the only stock rising in the Mag 7 on Monday. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Strikes Spur Rally in Oil: Markets Wrap
summary: A flare-up in geopolitical risks sent stocks and bonds lower as oil climbed, raising concerns about inflationary pressures that could make the Federal Reserve raise interest rates.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 31
summary: Oil rose as tensions spiked in the Middle East, with the US and Iran exchanging strikes for the first time in about a month and Tehran claiming a tanker was hit by mines in the critical Strait of Hormuz.

title: Trump Seeks to Appease Ranchers With Heifer Retention Insurance
summary: The US Agriculture Department is easing regulations for ranchers and small meat processors, in the latest effort to appease domestic producers while the Trump administration simultaneously boosts imports.

title: US Natural Gas Ticks Up on Hotter Forecasts, Cooling Demand
summary: US natural gas futures were up slightly as near-term forecasts showed hotter weather in the coming weeks, indicating increased cooling demand for the power-plant fuel as consumers crank up air-conditioning.

title: Major UAE Oil Refinery Returns to Full Capacity After War Hit
summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Co. has restored to full capacity one of the world’s biggest oil refineries that was hit earlier in the regional war, according to people familiar with the situation.

title: S&P 500 Falls Amid Oil Spike as Middle East Conflict Intensifies
summary: US stocks slumped on Monday, led by declines in interest-rate sensitive utilities shares while gains in energy companies offset losses elsewhere, after the US and Iran exchanged strikes for the first time in about a month.

title: PG&E, Edison International Stocks Plunge on California Wildfire Bill
summary: Shares of PG&E Corp., Edison International and Sempra plunged Monday after an effort by California Governor Gavin Newsom to shift wildfire liabilities from the state’s utilities failed.

title: Yen’s Breach of 160 Level Puts Market on Intervention Watch
summary: The yen’s breach of 160 versus the dollar underscores the Japanese currency’s vulnerability to further weakness and the heightened risk of authorities entering the market again to slow its decline.

title: Treasury 10-Year Yield Tops 4.75%, Highest Since January 2025
summary: The US 10-year yield topped 4.75% on Monday for the first time since January 2025 as rising oil prices bolstered expectations that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates.

title: Venezuela Deal a Bit of a Sideshow for Oil, Sankey Says
summary: “This diesel price is a colossal problem,” says Paul Sankey, president at Sankey Research, as he examines US plans to control more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil. Sankey says the industry is short of refining and that’s “the big issue” for the global market. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: No Urgency for Fed to Hike: Goncalves
summary: George Goncalves of MUFG discusses Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s hawkish Jackson Hole remarks, the outlook for inflation and interest rates, and what upcoming jobs and CPI data could mean for a potential Fed hike. He also examines Treasury yields, market expectations and the longer-term impact of AI on productivity and inflation. He joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic’s Mega-IPO Plan Looms Over Packed US Listing Calendar
summary: Anthropic PBC’s IPO is casting a long shadow over companies’ US listing plans, as they try to find room for their deals to grab attention after the Sept. 7 Labor Day holiday.

title: Adani Shares Lose $15 Billion as Closing Auction Fuels Swings
summary: Adani Group companies on Monday erased 1.4 trillion rupees ($15 billion) in market value, the most in about 21 months, as India’s closing auction drove sharp swings during a scheduled MSCI Inc. index rebalancing.

title: Saylor’s Strategy Restarts Bitcoin Buying, Spending $370 Million
summary: Strategy Inc. resumed Bitcoin purchases after a 10-week pause, returning to its signature accumulation strategy after the crypto bear market pressured its shares, weakened confidence in the financing model and prompted a balance-sheet overhaul.

title: India Auction Absorbs Record MSCI Flows Despite Price Swings
summary: India’s new closing auction system handled record turnover of almost 400 billion rupees ($4.2 billion) on Monday as billions of dollars of trades linked to rebalancing of MSCI Inc. indexes flowed through the mechanism, though dozens of stocks saw sharp price moves.

title: Technicians Cautious Ahead of S&P 500’s Worst Month Historically
summary: The outlook for earnings growth for the S&P 500 Index is bright following a blockbuster reporting season and multiple Wall Street strategists have raised their year-end targets for the benchmark. As the kids say nowadays: The vibes are immaculate.

title: Chile: reforma económica aumenta apetito por bonos de mayor riesgo
summary: Expectativas de que el gobierno de José Antonio Kast logrará reactivar la economía están elevando el apetito por bonos corporativos de menor grado en Chile.

title: Chile Bond Investors Test Riskier Debt on Growth Revival Bets
summary: Chilean investors are dipping a toe into lower-rated corporate bonds on bets that the new administration’s economic reform will revive growth.
